_note: Hand edits made in the viewer's side pane (tools/serve.mjs writes this). Key = "<source>:<place|region>:<name on the map>". Fields: name, lng, lat, kind, tier (1 village, 2 town, 3 city), rank (region label level 1-3), note, hidden (removed). Delete an entry to undo it, then run attach_notes.mjs.

placed:place:Valkith.note: Built among volcanic mountains; its cliffs look out over the Inner Sea to the north.
